verification.method: Upstream project metadata and LICENSE/COPYING files read through the GitHub REST API on the tag or branch named in each entry: first pass 2026-11-09 (compositor, shell, terminal, prompt, system information, screenshot annotation, audio, GTK and icon theme projects), extended 2026-11-10 for the typefaces, cursor theme and Papirus Folders. Where an upstream could not be reached, the entry says TODO(verify) and points at docs/UNVERIFIED.md instead of guessing.

intro: This repository is licensed as a whole under the GNU General Public License version 3.0; the full text is in LICENSE.txt and is not reproduced here.
iArch by Safari is an independent product. It ships configuration for third-party projects and a small amount of vendored third-party code and assets, listed below.

The product name shown in the desktop session is iArch by Safari. Upstream project names are intentionally kept out of the everyday UI; this file and the Settings page About -> Open-source licenses are the only places where third-party credit is displayed. See docs/BRANDING.md.
Packages that the installer only downloads from your distribution are licensed by that distribution. They are listed for completeness, not redistributed here.

kinds.vendored-code: Third-party source code stored inside this repository.
kinds.derived-config: Configuration or color values in this repository derived from a third-party project.
kinds.runtime-dependency: Third-party software this configuration targets or launches; not redistributed here.
kinds.asset: Binary or artwork assets stored inside this repository.
kinds.infrastructure: Third-party network service, repository or registry used by the installer or the shell.
kinds.provenance: Earlier publications of this same work, credited for history rather than reused as code.

components.name: adw-gtk3
components.purpose: GTK 3 theme used to match the shell look in classic GTK applications.

components.name: Fonts offered by the installer whose licenses were not verified
components.purpose: ttf-symbola and ttf-ms-fonts, installed by the printer-support step of the Arch installer.
components.upstream: ttf-ms-fonts is an AUR package of Microsoft's core fonts; ttf-symbola ships the Symbola face by George Douros.
components.notes: Neither license could be read from a reachable upstream: ttf-ms-fonts redistributes fonts under Microsoft's own end-user terms and is not open source, and Symbola's terms were not published in a place this repository could verify. Both are installed only when the user opts into printer support, and nothing in the session configuration requires them.

components.name: Bibata cursor theme
components.purpose: Pointer theme the session exports to Hyprland, XWayland and Qt.
components.notes: Bibata-Modern-Classic at size 24 is set through HYPRCURSOR_THEME, XCURSOR_THEME and QT_CURSOR_THEME. Neither installer installs a package that provides it; see TP-13.

components.name: Chaotic-AUR
components.purpose: Third-party Arch repository and keyring enabled by the Arch installer for prebuilt AUR packages.
components.notes: The installer edits /etc/pacman.conf and imports the signing key. Review before running; the package builds come from third parties.

components.name: DejaVu fonts
components.purpose: Wide-coverage fallback typeface installed by the Arch installer (ttf-dejavu).
components.license: Bitstream Vera license; DejaVu changes are in the public domain
components.copyright: Fonts are (c) Bitstream; glyphs imported from Arev fonts are (c) Tavmjong Bah
components.notes: License read from the first lines of the upstream LICENSE file on 2026-11-10.

components.name: fastfetch
components.purpose: System information display used in the terminal.
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2021-2023 Linus Dierheimer; Copyright (c) 2022-2026 Carter Li

components.name: fastfetch ASCII logo files
components.purpose: Selectable artwork for the system information display.
components.notes: Seven .icon files of artwork derived from anime franchises. Authorship and redistribution rights are not established.

components.name: fish shell
components.purpose: Interactive shell used by the terminal profile.
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 2005-2009 Axel Liljencrantz and fish-shell contributors
components.notes: Upstream COPYING also covers components under other licenses; see that file for the authoritative list.

components.name: The original dotfiles this repository started from
components.purpose: Safari's personal Arch Linux dotfiles, published on GitLab before this repository, under the names minimaLinux and minimaDots.
components.notes: This repository is that same continuing work, not a fork of someone else's project: the configuration, installers and history came from it. The project path was recovered from the GitLab badge links in the first commit of this repository's history (git show b3e20fc:README.md). gitlab.com is not reachable from the environment used to verify these notices, so the license text published there was not re-read; the older names survive in this repository only as frozen runtime identifiers and in historical documents, as docs/BRANDING.md explains.

components.name: HeSuVi HRIR audio assets
components.purpose: Impulse response WAV files selectable by the virtual surround convolver profile.
components.notes: 624 WAV files, about 32 MB. Several names refer to commercial vendor surround products, so the redistribution rights are not established. Review before publishing a release or mirroring this repository.

components.name: Hyprland
components.purpose: Wayland compositor. The session configuration is written in its Lua configuration API.

components.name: Hyprland Keybinds (Noctalia plugin)
components.purpose: Bar widget, panel and settings page that view and edit the Hyprland keybinds file.
components.copyright: Copyright (c) tonekneeo (year not stated in manifest.json)
components.notes: Authored for this repository and declared MIT in its own manifest.json. It follows the Noctalia plugin API conventions but is not a copy of the upstream keybind-cheatsheet plugin, which has a different id, author, version and file set.

components.name: JetBrains Mono
components.purpose: Terminal typeface requested by the kitty configuration.
components.copyright: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
components.notes: Both files request "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono", the Nerd Fonts patched build of this face. License read from the upstream repository's LICENSE file on 2026-11-10.

components.name: Jinja2
components.purpose: Template engine that renders iarch/lib/templates/gtk4.css.j2 and gtk3.css.j2 into the GTK 4 and GTK 3 glass overlays, both for the sheets committed in .config/ and whenever iarch-theme apply re-renders them on the user's machine.
components.notes: Verified on PyPI: version 3.1.6, classifier 'License :: OSI Approved :: BSD License', requires MarkupSafe>=2.0. The distribution package names were not verified against a package index this sandbox can reach (docs/UNVERIFIED.md TP-16).

components.name: kitty
components.purpose: GPU accelerated terminal emulator.

components.name: MarkupSafe
components.purpose: Required dependency of Jinja2; imported whenever a GTK sheet is rendered.
components.notes: Credited because Jinja2 declares MarkupSafe>=2.0 as a hard requirement, so it is present wherever this project renders a sheet. The installed version was not pinned here.

components.name: Nerd Fonts
components.purpose: Patched font build that supplies the powerline and icon glyphs kitty renders.
components.notes: Upstream LICENSE states the split explicitly: patched fonts in folders carrying an OFL file are SIL Open Font License 1.1, the patcher source is MIT. Read 2026-11-10.

components.name: Noctalia
components.purpose: Wayland desktop shell: bar, dock, launcher, Control Center, notifications, lock screen, greeter and Settings. Launched by the session and driven with the noctalia command.
components.notes: Configuration keys in this repository were checked against the upstream v5.4.1 schema; see docs/UNVERIFIED.md for what still needs a live-session check.

components.name: Noctalia plugin registry
components.purpose: Remote plugin index the shell can install plugins from.
components.license: No license file published upstream at verification time
components.notes: Referenced by URL only; no plugin source is downloaded into this repository by the installer. The registry publishes no top-level LICENSE file, and each plugin carries its own manifest license.

components.name: Noto Color Emoji
components.purpose: Emoji coverage installed by the Arch installer (noto-fonts-emoji).
components.notes: License read from the upstream repository metadata on 2026-11-10.

components.name: Papirus Folders
components.purpose: Folder colour script installed alongside the Papirus icon theme.
components.notes: License read from the upstream repository metadata on 2026-11-10.

components.name: Papirus icon theme
components.purpose: Icon theme selected by the session presets.

components.name: Pillow (the PIL fork)
components.purpose: Imaging library imported by iarch/cli/gen_wallpapers.py to render the generated preset wallpapers at 3840x2160 and encode them as WebP.
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 1997-2011 Secret Labs AB; Copyright (c) 1995-2011 Fredrik Lundh and contributors; Copyright (c) 2010 Jeffrey 'Alex' Clark and contributors
components.notes: Its LICENSE states Pillow is licensed under the open source MIT-CMU License; the GitHub license API reports NOASSERTION for that wording, so the licence was read from the LICENSE file directly. Not a runtime dependency of an installed session: the generated WebP files ship in the repository, and Pillow is only needed to regenerate them.

components.name: PipeWire filter-chain virtual surround configuration
components.purpose: Convolver sink that plays 7.1 virtual surround through stereo headphones using HRIR files.
components.notes: The convolver graph follows the upstream filter-chain virtual surround example. Paths and the HeSuVi 14-channel WAV layout were adapted for this repository.

components.name: Satty
components.purpose: Screenshot annotation tool bound to a keybind.

components.name: Session helper utilities
components.purpose: Small tools the session calls for screenshots, clipboard, media keys, volume and policy authentication: hyprshot, grim, slurp, wl-clip-persist, pamixer, playerctl, polkit-gnome-authentication-agent-1, gnome-keyring-daemon, EasyEffects, ddcutil.
components.notes: Installed from the distribution or AUR; each package ships its own license. Nothing from these projects is stored in this repository.

components.name: Starship
components.purpose: Cross-shell prompt.

components.name: Tokyo Night color values
components.purpose: Terminal and shell color scheme values.
components.notes: Color values only. The Apache License 2.0 text is available in the upstream repository; no upstream source code is stored here.
